name: Wanted: Gath'Ilzogg
summary: In Redridge, Magistrate Solomon offers a bounty for Gath'Ilzogg, the warlord behind Blackrock's invasion of Stonewatch. Anyone who storms the conquered keep and brings back the commander's severed head may claim it.

sections.title: The Warlord of Stonewatch
sections.body: Gath'Ilzogg leads Blackrock raids across the Redridge Mountains. His orcs seized Stonewatch Keep, once a human bastion, and turned it into a stronghold for attacks on nearby settlements. From its highest ramparts, he plans further strikes against Lakeshire. Redridge may be cut off from the rest of the kingdom.

sections.title: A Town Pushed to the Brink
sections.body: Stormwind's royal army has sent no reinforcements to the border, so Magistrate Solomon acts on his own. Lakeshire lacks the soldiers to retake Stonewatch Keep by force. Solomon offers a public bounty on Gath'Ilzogg, hoping to break Blackrock's leadership and begin reclaiming the keep for the crown.

faq.answer: Gath'Ilzogg is an orc warlord who leads the Blackrock forces occupying Stonewatch. He directed the keep's conquest and is responsible for frequent deadly raids against Lakeshire's human settlers.
Gath'Ilzogg is entrenched at the top of Stonewatch Keep, in the eastern crags of the Redridge Mountains. Blackrock champions and bodyguards guard him.

faq.q: Why is Magistrate Solomon offering a bounty instead of sending soldiers?
faq.answer: Lakeshire's town guard is stretched thin, and Stormwind's crown has sent no troops to relieve the region. Magistrate Solomon relies on mercenaries and independent adventurers to face major threats.

faq.q: What happens after Gath'Ilzogg is killed?
faq.answer: Magistrate Solomon sees Gath'Ilzogg's death as the first step toward driving out the orcs and eventually reclaiming Stonewatch Keep for the Kingdom of Stormwind. Blackrock forces remain strong in the region.

faq.q: Why did the Blackrock orcs invade Stonewatch Keep?
faq.answer: The Blackrock clan uses Stonewatch Keep as a fortified forward base high in the Redridge Mountains. From there, its forces control the passes and raid human settlements.

faq.q: Who claims the bounty once Gath'Ilzogg is dead?
faq.answer: Bring Gath'Ilzogg's head to Magistrate Solomon at Lakeshire's town hall as proof of his defeat.

angles.text: Striking down Gath'Ilzogg removes one of the kingdom's most immediate military threats on its eastern border. Lakeshire's citizens gain vital breathing room.
For Stormwind's people, Stonewatch Keep was hard won. Gath'Ilzogg slaughtered innocents when it fell, making this bounty a matter of bitter vengeance.
At Stonewatch Keep's summit, you face the hardened veteran warriors and brute strength of the Dark Horde's frontline command.
